params.feature_compute_note: Causal trailing RQA computed every 2 bars and held (causal forward-hold) for runtime; signal/z/exec logic unchanged.
params.rte_definition: RTE = Shannon entropy (nats) of white vertical line length (recurrence-time gap) distribution p_w=n_w/sum_u n_u over qualifying gaps w>=w_min (w_min=2) excluding i==j; RTE=-sum_w p_w*ln(p_w); fail-closed if <2 distinct qualifying gap lengths or entropy non-finite/non-positive
params.white_diag_line_length_divergence_defini: WHITE_DIAG_LINE_LENGTH_DIVERGENCE = max(len_k_white)-mean(len_k_white) over off-diagonal diagonals k!=0 with >=1 qualifying white diagonal segment of consecutive 0s (length >= w_min=2), where len_k_white = mean qualifying white segment length on diagonal k. Fail-closed if <2 qualifying diagonals or divergence <=0/non-finite/undefined.
params.white_segment_definition: white diagonal segment = run of consecutive 0-cells (non-recurrent) along an off-diagonal diagonal k!=0 of the RP; qualifying if length >= w_min
params.gap_definition: white vertical gap length w = number of consecutive 0-cells between successive recurrent points in a column (excluding trivial self at i==j); qualifying if w>=w_min
